messages:
Mike (Sales): quick handoff — Aurora (enterprise, $480k ARR) signed last week. Contract start 2026-04-01. Key ask: SSO + Snowflake ingestion for product analytics. Sales flagged timeline concerns: customer expects Q2 feature launch; integration delays = renewal risk (time-to-value). Handing off to @Sophia (CS). Primary contacts: Emma (PM), Raj (Infra). Docs/contract in SF link: https://redwood.sales/aurora-4302 :eyes:

Sophia (CS): got it, taking ownership. Thanks @Mike. I'll schedule a kickoff and collect technical access. Can you paste the SF link to the SOW and any P0 success metrics? Also confirm whether they bought premium support (SLA).

Mike (Sales): SOW in the SF link above — SOW section 2 lists success metrics: "initial 3 workflows live, <200ms p99 for embeddings queries". They purchased Enterprise + 24/7 support. Procurement expects weekly status updates first 6 weeks.

Anita (Onboarding): I can run the onboarding playbook. Tentative owner: Anita -> setup, Sophia -> success ops. Need: (1) SSO metadata (IdP SAML/Okta) (2) Snowflake account + role with read access to staging bucket (3) list of 3 sample datasets. Proposed checklist:
```
- Kickoff call (1h) with PM + infra
- SSO exchange (IdP metadata)
- Snowflake creds (read role)
- Ingestion dry run (sample file)
- Perf baseline + p99 measurement
- Weekly status update (CS)
```

Sophia (CS): adding stakeholders: Emma (PM), Raj (Infra), CTO is Lina (decision escalation). I'll send a brief one-pager for execs. Assigning tasks: Anita = onboarding tasks above; Kevin (Support) = monitoring + alert onboarding; Lucas (Eng) = integration triage if ingestion fails.

Kevin (Support): noted. For monitoring, I'll enable logs forwarding to our observability workspace and create an alerts runbook for ingestion failures and SSO auth errors. Need: endpoint for log shipping and example error patterns.

Lucas (Eng): heads-up — there was a known corner-case with Snowflake staged files and newline handling that can cause parsing errors. If ingestion uses COPY INTO with compressed files, we should confirm compression & delimiter. If they hit the parsing issue I'll need sample file + error snippet. Minimal triage steps I need:
```
1) sample CSV (<=10MB)
2) error log from runner (stack + timestamp)
3) Snowflake COPY command used
```

Mike (Sales): looping in Emma and Raj on thread. Emma, can you drop the Okta metadata and a sample dataset by EOD? Raj, please share an infra contact for Snowflake permissions. :thumbsup:

OnboardBot: calendar invite sent — Aurora kickoff: Wed Apr 6 10:00 PST (1h). Attendees: Mike, Sophia, Anita, Emma, Raj, Kevin, Lucas.

Sophia (CS): next steps summary (I'll own communication):
- Owner: Sophia (CS) overall; Anita = onboarding; Kevin = support monitoring; Lucas = eng triage
- Immediate asks (due by EOD tomorrow): Emma -> IdP metadata + sample dataset; Raj -> Snowflake role + contact
- Kickoff: Wed Apr 6 10:00 PST (OnboardBot invite sent)
- Weekly cadence: status email every Friday for first 6 weeks

Sophia (CS): marking renewal risk as "watch" — will escalate to Sales ops if onboarding slips >2 weeks past planned timeline. :white_check_mark:
